description: This Python script implements a Streamlit web application for chatting with documents using the LlamaIndex library. It includes functions for setting up different language model service contexts (Gemini, OpenAI, custom), processing uploaded documents to create or load indexes, and managing the chat interface and session state.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a Gemini language model and embedding model, then creates and sets a global service context.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up an OpenAI language model and embedding model, then creates and sets a global service context.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a custom service context using OpenAI and GooglePaLMEmbedding models.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for Gemini model querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for OpenAI model querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for custom model querying.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main Streamlit application function that manages file uploads, index creation, chat interface, and session cleanup.
